summary: Fiscal years run December 1 to November 30 and are named for the year they end
detail: FY2026 = December 1, 2025 to November 30, 2026. Worksheet columns are headed '2025-2026'; audits are 'for the year ended November 30'. period_fy is the ending year, as for the city.

summary: Year-to-date columns of the budget worksheets are not stored as facts
detail: The worksheets print 'Thru 9/30/25', 'Thru 10/6/26' or 'YTD Activity' (partial-year activity) beside the full-year columns. They are not a full-year actual or a budget, so they are not facts; they stay in data/boone_county_il/extracted/<doc>_lines.csv (measure ytd).

summary: Worksheet 'Total Activity' columns are preliminary actuals
detail: The 'Total Activity' column of a worksheet is the county's ledger activity for the closed year as of the document date; the audit's actual (basis actual_audited) supersedes it, and the General Fund audit schedule excludes subfunds the ledger includes.

summary: Printed worksheet totals that differ from their lines
detail: Accepted source differences, each with its reason in data/boone_county_il/overrides/<doc>.csv: FY2025 document: three funds whose printed revenue totals are 0.00 above a non-zero line (163 Sale in Error FY2025 final, 166 Schnell and 167 Wolfram memorial funds FY2024 budget and YTD); FY2027 preliminary: General Fund FY2026 revenue total $15,000 below its lines. Every other printed total equals its lines (FY2027 prints whole dollars and may differ by half a dollar per line).

summary: Prior-year budget columns of a later worksheet differ from the adopted figure on some accounts
detail: FY2025 final budget vs the FY2026 document's FY2025 budget column: 16 of 793 shared accounts differ (e.g. Public Safety Sales Tax Fund interest 8,000 vs 10,000); FY2024 budget between the FY2025 and FY2026 documents: 4 of 793; FY2026 final vs the FY2027 preliminary's FY2026 column: 8 of 790 (e.g. health insurance 2,950,000 vs 2,945,040). The document's own current column is the adopted budget (basis adopted); the later column is basis prior_doc_budget.

summary: FY2018-FY2023 audits print one 'Final Budget' column; FY2015-17 and FY2024-25 print 'Original and Final Budget'
detail: The county does not amend its budget during the year. Audits that print 'Original and Final Budget' give both bases (flag combined_column); audits that print only 'Final Budget' give basis audit_final (flag final_budget_column).

summary: The General Fund schedule is fund 001 only; the statement's General column includes subfunds
detail: From FY2020 the governmental funds statement's General column (GASB 54) adds subfunds (payroll clearing, E-Citation, forfeited funds, towing ...) to fund 001. The audit's schedule of revenues and expenditures covers fund 001 alone (FY2025: revenues 20,439,677 vs 20,566,439; expenditures 21,030,404 vs 21,073,420). FY2015-FY2019 the two agree to the dollar.
evidence: FY2025 audit combining statement - General Fund by subfund; tests/test_boone_county.py

summary: General Fund expenditure schedule totals that repeat the previous year or add a budget the lines lack
detail: FY2024 and FY2025 print a 5,000 budget on 'Total debt service' (principal and interest lines have no budget); FY2024's total expenditures variance includes it; FY2025's Total debt service actual (209,303) and Total supervisor of educational service region (84,000 / 77,995) are the FY2024 figures. Items are stored; the stale totals are not.

summary: Per-fund schedule slips in the audits
detail: FY2015 IMRF budget net change 1,657,072 (should be (19,221)); FY2016 and FY2017 Capital Projects budget net change positive (should be negative); FY2021-22 Recorder's Automation transfers out without parentheses.

FY2015-17: General, County Bridge, IMRF/Retirement, County Motor Fuel Tax, Nonmajor; FY2018-20: Other Governmental; FY2021 adds the American Rescue Plan Grant fund; FY2022-24 fold Bridge and IMRF into Other/Nonmajor; FY2025 shows Motor Fuel Tax and Bridge as major again ('Change in financial reporting entity' moves 9,398,394 out of nonmajor at December 1, 2024). Column names per audit in entities/boone_county_il/audit_fund_columns.csv.
evidence: FY2025 audit statement of revenues, expenditures and changes (page 37)

summary: Opening balances restated in FY2021 and FY2023
detail: General Fund opening balance FY2021 restated by +100,024 (Note 15); total governmental funds +850,726 (FY2020 closing to FY2021 opening) and -839,679 (FY2022 closing to FY2023 opening).

summary: Funds with no per-fund budget-and-actual schedule
detail: The per-fund schedules cover budgeted funds only; their ending balances add up exactly to total governmental funds less the General column in FY2021 and FY2022, and fall $0.2M-$6.1M short in other years (funds the county does not budget, e.g. recent bond and employee health funds).
